note: Written by tools/release.mjs from gas/model.json with tools/gas-plan.mjs (the planning rule); read by test/integration/FloorPlan.t.sol, which builds each shape at `k`, checks the kernel's quote equals `prefixFloor`/`finalReserve`, and proves the publication admitted under the per-transaction cap.

loneNegatives.what: lone negatives (first masks) on a one-word topic

firstTagsDepth8New.what: first tags on one new 8-word path, every position and roll-up new (case i)

firstTagsDepth64New.what: first tags on one new 64-word path, every position and roll-up new (case i)

firstTagsDepth8Existing.what: first tags at existing positions of an 8-word topic, the author's roll-ups existing (case iv)

firstTagsDepth64Existing.what: first tags at existing positions of a 64-word topic, the author's roll-ups existing (case iv)

secondAuthorDepth8.what: a second author's first tags at existing positions of an 8-word topic, its roll-ups new (case iii)

tagMasks.what: masks of asserted tags on a one-word topic (UNBIND from BOUND)

tagReleases.what: releases of asserted tags on a one-word topic

tagRestores.what: restores of masked tags on a one-word topic (BIND from MASKED)

tagNumberChanges.what: number changes on asserted tags on a one-word topic (a REBIND to the same target with a new number)

masksOfMasks.what: masks of masks on a one-word topic (UNBIND from MASKED with a new number; priced as masks of asserted tags, an upper bound)

folderRebinds.what: re-binds of root-folder entries to another file

repeatPublishes.what: repeat PUBLISHes of existing 10-byte files-name/3 records

publishesAndTags.what: a fresh 10-byte name record and a first tag on a one-word topic per unit (2 actions each)

registrationChunk.what: a registration chunk: fresh 12-byte topic-word/1 pages

tagYesesAfterLoneNoes.what: yeses after lone noes on a one-word topic (a BIND on a head that never bound: bindTagAfterNo)

createFilesAtRemovedNames.what: create-file recipes at names the author removed from the root folder (5 actions each: the name PUBLISH a repeat, the folder bind a restore to the new file)

createFilesAtRemovedNamesNoName.what: create-file recipes at names the author removed from the root folder, with no name PUBLISH (4 actions each)

movesIntoRemovedNames.what: moves of root-folder files into names the author removed from another folder (3 actions each: the name PUBLISH a repeat, RELEASE, restore)

movesIntoRemovedNamesNoName.what: moves of root-folder files into names the author removed from another folder, with no name PUBLISH (2 actions each)

movesToFresh.what: moves of root-folder files to fresh names in another folder, the names published before (2 actions each: RELEASE at the root, BIND FOLDER fresh)

movesToFreshGuarded.what: the same moves guarded over both heads of every move (1 principal × 2k positions, all written)

folderMasks.what: masks of root-folder entries (UNBIND of BOUND heads)

folderMasksGuarded.what: the same masks guarded over their heads (1 × k, all written)

folderRestores.what: restores of masked root-folder entries to their kept files (BIND of MASKED heads with a kept target; priced by restoreFolder)

folderRestoresGuarded.what: the same restores guarded over their heads (1 × k, all written)

tagNumberChangesGuarded.what: number changes on asserted tags on a one-word topic, guarded over their heads (1 × k, all written)

edits.what: edits of the author's files (PUBLISH files-child/1 form 0 with an 18-byte document, BIND HEAD re-bind; 2 actions each)

editsLensGuarded.what: the same edits guarded by a 64-principal lens at each file's HEAD position (64 × k: the author's k heads written, 63 other authors' BOUND HEADs per file, two words each)

editsLensOneGuarded.what: one edit guarded by a 64-principal lens at the file's HEAD position (64 × 1: the author's head written, 63 other authors' BOUND HEADs, two words each); fixed at one edit

creates.what: CREATEs (a publication that touches no head)
